# **Description**

 

**·**   	**Upload the required LED control program to the Developed a basic Arduino-based LED control circuit to demonstrate digital output control using an Arduino**

# **Procedure**

**·**   	**Arduino.**  
**·**   	**Observe the LED operation according to the programmed output. anode and cathode terminals.**  
**·**   	**Place the LED on the breadboard and identify its Connect LED to a digital output pin of the Arduino through a current limiting resistor.**  
**·**   	**Connect the cathode of the LED to the GND pin of the Arduino.**  
**·**   	**Connect the Arduino to the computer using a USB cable.**

# **Working**

**·**   	**The Arduino acts as the control unit of the circuit .It provides a digital output signal to the LED when the output pin is set to high ,current flows through the LED and it illuminates .When the pin is set to low ,the LED turns OFF.**
